verdict.rationale: The docs show parallel agent orchestration: multiple agents across independent projects, parallel agents in the CLI, and native Git worktree support for isolated background folders. Results can be reviewed through Artifacts, code diffs and a Review Changes view. However, nothing documents running several attempts of the same task side by side, comparing them, and choosing one. The parallelism described is aimed at splitting work or running separate projects. Missing for 10: an explicit best-of-N or multi-attempt feature for a single task, a side-by-side comparison of attempts, a select-and-merge workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
